contract: Socket.IO outgoing rss_feed_open: emitted once per successful feed open (item, collection or series) with the minified feed payload {id, entityType, entityId, feedUrl, meta{title, description, preventIndexing, ownerName, ownerEmail}} to every authenticated socket of every user (root and non-admin alike). Rejected opens, opens by non-admins and unauthenticated sockets produce no event; reopening a feed emits again with the new id.
exceptions: force is not applicable: the feed event producers (open, close, item/collection deletion) have no force, hard or override mode.
Emission timing is asserted through the socket wait window (the event is delivered while the HTTP response is produced); exact scheduling is not asserted.
Revoked-session and disconnected-socket variants are covered by the realtime packet's auth/socket records, not duplicated here.

invariants.contract: Each successful POST /api/feeds/{item,collection,series}/:id/open emits exactly one rss_feed_open whose single argument equals the minified feed the route returned (id, entityType, entityId, feedUrl, meta.title, meta.description, meta.preventIndexing, meta.ownerName, meta.ownerEmail and no other client-read field), delivered to the root socket and to a non-admin user's socket with identical payloads and to no unauthenticated socket. Two opens emit two events in creation order; a reopen after close emits the new feed id with the same feedUrl. Opens rejected by the admin middleware (403), the auth layer (401), a used slug, an unknown entity or a source without audio tracks emit no event.
